new_page.h1: Highgate Houses for Sale | Burnaby Real Estate

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Highgate. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Highgate, Burnaby: 6 houses listed at the end of September 2026 and 2 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 33% on only 6 listed, too few to read as a market type. By listings that is number 25 of 35 Burnaby communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Highgate fell from 7 in June to 6 in September (−14.3%), and 6 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 1.3% of Burnaby’s 458 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Highgate?
Highgate also had 71 condos and townhomes listed and 9 sold in September, against 6 houses listed. The Highgate condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Highgate home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

15 houses sold in Highgate with a median price of $1,500,000 (the middle half sold between $1,420,000 and $1,645,000), taking a median of 57 days to sell at 96.5% of the last list price; 7% sold above list. They had a median $686 per square foot, a median year built of 1955 and a median lot of 6,000 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Highgate?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 6 houses listed in Highgate. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Highgate a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Highgate had a sales ratio of 33% on only 6 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Highgate from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 6 houses sold in Highgate over those 4 months, out of 199 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Highgate?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Highgate sell for?
faq.a: 15 houses sold in Highgate between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,500,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Highgate?
faq.a: The median was 57 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.5% of the last list price (7% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
